lead: The tools of a table, on the right of its toolbar: refresh, a fixed header, which columns to show and in which order, and export. Each button is shown when its props are given; what they do is yours. With [DataTable](/data-table) it is the toolbar of a list page.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Hide or move a column in the columns popover; refresh spins while the list loads.

fixed.title: Fixed header
fixed.description: The button turns `stickyHeader` of the table on and off (the box here has a height; in a page it is `Page fill` and `Card fill`). `useFixedHeader` starts as fixed and remembers what the user chose, per key, in this browser.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.columns: The list in the columns popover
